class.name: ResonanceProbeVolume
class.brief_description: Native probe volume for baking and sampling room reverb.
class.description: Defines a 3D region where Steam Audio places probes and bakes reflection, pathing, and optional static source/listener data. Probe layout follows [member generation_type] and [member spacing]; results are stored in [member probe_data]. Bake via the inspector Bake button or Project -> Tools -> Nexus Resonance -> Bake ([url=#ResonanceBakeConfig]ResonanceBakeConfig[/url] on [member bake_config]). Open that config page for reflection type, pathing, static passes, and quality settings; sub-resources have no class help button in the inspector. To skip probes in a region, add [ResonanceProbeExclusion] nodes as descendants of this volume (any depth). Enabled exclusion boxes remove candidates before bake. Probe positions are world-fixed after bake; re-bake if you move or scale this volume. Deleting a volume still referenced by [member ResonancePlayer.pathing_probe_volume] can trigger a Godot engine error; clear references first or use Project -> Tools -> Nexus Resonance -> Unlink Probe Volume References.

method.name: bake_probes
method.description: Deprecated; scheduled for removal in 1.0. Reflection-only bake. Use the inspector Bake button or [code]ResonanceBakeRunner.run_bake([volume])[/code] for the full pipeline (pathing, static passes, hashes, backups).

method.name: bake_probes_with_floor_points
method.description: Deprecated; scheduled for removal in 1.0. Reflection-only bake at precomputed floor points. Prefer the full bake pipeline instead of calling this directly.

method.name: generate_probes_on_floor_raycast
method.description: For Uniform Floor mode: raycasts downward to find floor hits and returns probe positions in world space. Requires collision geometry on the floor. Main thread only.

method.name: reload_probe_batch
method.description: Reloads [member probe_data] into [ResonanceServer] without restarting the game. Call after pathing or static source/listener bakes update the resource.

method.name: get_bake_params_hash
method.description: Hash of volume layout parameters ([member region_size], [member spacing], [member generation_type], etc.). Used to detect outdated [member probe_data]. [member ResonanceBakeConfig.bake_num_threads] is excluded (duration only).

method.name: get_viz_color_state
method.description: Editor probe viz state: 0 = gray (missing/outdated), 1 = blue (up to date), 2 = red (settings mismatch).

method.name: set_viz_color_state
method.description: Sets editor probe visualization color. Called internally when bake status or config changes.

method.name: notify_runtime_config_changed
method.description: Called by [ResonanceRuntime] when [url=#ResonanceRuntimeConfig]ResonanceRuntimeConfig[/url] reflection or pathing settings change. Reloads the probe batch and refreshes viz state.

method.name: ensure_default_resources
method.description: Ensures [member probe_data] and [member bake_config] exist. Used by the editor when creating or inspecting this volume ([code]_ready[/code] alone is not reliable on node create). Safe to call repeatedly.

method.name: collect_exclusion_boxes
method.description: Returns enabled descendant [ResonanceProbeExclusion] boxes as dictionaries ([code]xform[/code], [code]size[/code]), sorted by node path. Used by bake and preview.

method.name: notify_exclusion_changed
method.description: Called when a child [ResonanceProbeExclusion] changes. Refreshes editor probe preview and contributes to bake outdated detection via [method get_bake_params_hash].

method.name: add_bake_source
method.description: Appends a [ResonancePlayer] bake target. Accepts [NodePath] or [Node] (resolved via [method Node.get_path_to]). Dedupes; no-op if empty or invalid. Does not bake.

method.name: remove_bake_source
method.description: Removes matching entries from [member bake_sources]. Accepts [NodePath] or [Node]. No-op if missing.

method.name: add_bake_listener
method.description: Appends a [ResonanceListener] bake target. Accepts [NodePath] or [Node] (resolved via [method Node.get_path_to]). Dedupes; no-op if empty or invalid. Does not bake.

method.name: remove_bake_listener
method.description: Removes matching entries from [member bake_listeners]. Accepts [NodePath] or [Node]. No-op if missing.

members.member: [url=#ResonanceBakeConfig]ResonanceBakeConfig[/url] for this volume. Auto-created when empty in the editor ([method ensure_default_resources], inspector). When null at bake time, [method ResonanceBakeConfig.create_default] is used.
[ResonanceProbeData] resource with baked probes. Auto-created when empty. Save the scene after baking. Required for baked reverb at runtime.
Probe region size in meters (X, Y, Z). Probes are placed inside this box.
Probe layout: Centroid (0) = center only; Uniform Floor (1) = horizontal grid at [member height_above_floor]; Volume (2) = 3D grid with [member spacing].
Distance in meters between probes (0.5-20). Smaller spacing means more probes, longer bakes, and higher quality.
Probe plane height above the floor for Uniform Floor mode (0.1-5). Typical ear height is about 1.2-1.5 m. Read-only unless [member generation_type] is Uniform Floor (1).
Draws probe spheres in the editor when this volume is selected. Editor-only; does not affect bake or runtime.
Editor scale of probe sphere gizmos (0.1-3). Does not affect bake or runtime.

NodePaths to scene-tree roots (nodes or instanced scene roots) for the inspector Update Targets action. Scan finds [ResonancePlayer] and [ResonanceListener] under each root and replaces [member bake_sources] / [member bake_listeners].

NodePaths to [ResonancePlayer] nodes for Static Source bakes. Each valid entry runs one STATICSOURCE pass when [member ResonanceBakeConfig.static_source_enabled] is true on [member bake_config]. Prefer [method add_bake_source] / [method remove_bake_source] at runtime.

NodePaths to [ResonanceListener] nodes for Static Listener bakes. Each valid entry runs one STATICLISTENER pass when [member ResonanceBakeConfig.static_listener_enabled] is true on [member bake_config]. Prefer [method add_bake_listener] / [method remove_bake_listener] at runtime.
Influence radius in meters (1-50000) for static source/listener bakes when the target node has no custom radius.
